text: P1 rwb-source-data owns the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views under the ACE view contract, so all 304 view fields carry P1 rwb-source-data (recovery view) in the Owner column and no other service reads a view.
why: The Ownership Map lists tables and not views, and the architecture gives the views, their grants and the boundary rule to rwb-source-data; leaving 304 fields without an owner would break the WP rule that every owner comes from the map.

text: Three channels are added to the inventory: the Kafka event, the Temporal workflow input and history, and the application log. Each field carries its rule, and each channel has one owner and one control.
